: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SANJAY DHAR, JUDGE
ORDER 11.11.2024 Vide order dated, 07.02.2024, the respondents were directed to file better affidavit indicating the exact stage of acquisition proceedings.

Pursuant to the said order, an affidavit has been filed by Sh. Rakesh Minhas Deputy Commissioner,
Kathua in which it has been submitted that vide letter dated 13.03.2024, a request has been made to Chief Engineer, PMGSY, Jammu to place an indent for acquisition of the land so as to enable him to proceed further in the matter in accordance with the provisions of Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: It has been further stated in the affidavit that up to the date of filing of this affidavit, no communication has been received from the Chief Engineer, PMGSY, Jammu.

In view of the above, Chief Engineer, PMGSY, Jammu is directed to appear in person on the next date along with the record of the case so that it can be ascertained as to why the proceedings in respect of the acquisition of the land of the petitioner are not being processed further at his end.
Copy of this order be furnished to Mr Ravinder Gupta, learned AAG for ensuring its compliance.
